draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.73, the 5th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 2nd of 11 at QB. He went 2nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2023) ranked 3rd in passing yards among the 11 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders. 24 career games and 24 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 6 AV in 2025 against a career-best 20 in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 6 (23rd percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 quarterback who played: 1,262 passing yards against a median of 1,765, below the norm.
